summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc., a foreign private issuer formerly named Chijet Motor Company, furnished a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026 covering the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing supplies unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements (Exhibit 99.1) and operating and financial review and prospects (Exhibit 99.2), incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. This is a routine semi-annual reporting filing; no risk-arb angle or deal terms are presented.
